description: This file defines the BuzzPostShareAPI class, a REST API endpoint for listing shares of a specific post within the 'Buzz' plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving share data, validation rules, and integrates with services and models related to Buzz shares.

classes.name: BuzzPostShareAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for retrieving all shares associated with a specific Buzz post, utilizing Buzz services and models within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles the GET request to list all shares of a specific post. Validates the post ID, retrieves share data and count, and returns a collection result.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, ensuring the post ID is positive and applying sorting/pagination rules.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Method to create a new share; currently not implemented, throws an exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a share; not implemented.

methods.description: Method to delete a share; currently not implemented, throws an exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation; not implemented.
